description: Match begins at Gillette Stadium.
Bounou saves Mbappé's early effort.
Upamecano's close-range header from a corner is blocked.
Minor foul in midfield.
Foul on Ounahi in the France defensive third.
Morocco attacker flagged offside.
Dembélé's header is blocked.
Rabiot's header from a corner is saved by Bounou.
France's second corner of the half.
Mazraoui fouls Mbappé in the box; penalty given to France.
Mbappé's tame spot-kick is saved by Bounou.
Foul on Rabiot, free kick to France.
Dembélé's effort from the edge of the box is saved.
Doué's low drive from 17 yards is blocked.
France attacker flagged offside.
Koundé's header from a corner is blocked (3rd France corner of the half).
Half time: France 0-0 Morocco. France lead on xG 1.87-0.04 despite the missed penalty.
Digne strikes the crossbar with a swerving left-footed effort.
Foul on Olise in the final third.
France corner from the right.
Mbappé finds the far corner, set up by Doué. 1-0.
Sofyan Amrabat replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
Soufiane Rahimi replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
Issa Diop booked for serious foul play.
Dembélé's shot creeps beyond Bounou to double the lead, assisted by Mbappé. 2-0.
Foul on Barcola/Doué area, free kick to France.
Warren Zaïre-Emery replaces Manu Koné (Zaïre-Emery's World Cup debut).
Gessime Yassine replaces Brahim Díaz.
Zakaria El Ouahdi replaces Anass Salah-Eddine.
Bradley Barcola replaces Désiré Doué.
Jean-Philippe Mateta replaces Kylian Mbappé.
France's fifth corner of the match.
Amine Sbaï replaces Chemsdine Talbi.
Malo Gusto replaces Jules Koundé.
Hakimi's stoppage-time free kick flies over.
Full time: France 2-0 Morocco. France advance to face Spain/Belgium in the semi-final.
